worked_solution:
We start by factoring the function as much as possible and canceling the common factors:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{2{x}^{2}-8}{{x}^{2}+7x+10} & =\frac{2({x}^{2}-4)}{(x+5)(x+2)} \\  & =\frac{2({x}^{2}-{2}^{2})}{(x+5)(x+2)} \\  & =\frac{2(x-2)(x+2)}{(x+5)(x+2)} \\  & =\frac{2(x-2)\cancel{(x+2)}}{(x+5)\cancel{(x+2)}} \\  & =\frac{2(x-2)}{x+5}\end{aligned}
$$

We now set the denominator equal to zero:

$$
x+5=0\,⟹\,x=-5
$$

So the *only* vertical asymptote is at $x=-5.$
